verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Lago exposing its own billing data as an MCP *server* for external AI assistants (lago-docs-9, lago-docs-26, lago-probe-4), the reverse of the story. There is no documentation of Lago's AI agents (Dunning Agent, Agent SDK) supporting ingestion of external MCP servers as tools, so the client-side capability described in the story is unevidenced.
